summary: Preset entity is the field-meaning authority for CanonicalPreset and PresetBody, the canonical prompt-manager model shared by the SillyTavern, RoleCall, Marinara, and Lumiverse adapters. It covers ordered prompt blocks, system, user, assistant, and tool roles, hierarchical groups, sampler and generation settings, templates, behavior, API and media options, and interactive choices. Generic CLI commands, Library, Workbench, and Kit lifecycle tools operate on the same body. LiveBuild preview orders enabled blocks and estimates tokens without resolving macros, groups, or choices. behaviorRefs links standalone regex sets, while quickReplyRefs links standalone quick-reply sets; Press resolves both by kind and id when exporting a preset bundle. Escrow remains reserved for source-wire details that editors do not author. Other SillyTavern preset files land here when Bunraku can use them: KoboldAI, TextGen and NovelAI sampler sets onto samplers with a samplerSet flag, system prompts as the main block, and reasoning templates as a reasoning field the scene transcript uses; each is seeded with ST's stock prompt order. Instruct and context templates are the separate promptformat piece. A preset is a writing setup with the Script Sheet: separate kinds read one way through asPreset.

sections.title: How to read the field tables
sections.summary: Field tables are generated by scripts/docs-fields.ts and embedded verbatim; never hand-edit a cell, improve the schema doc comment and regenerate. Field is the canonical name with trailing question mark for optional. Type is the schema TypeScript type. Producers lists wire formats verified for the shape even without a shipping adapter, or dash when untagged. Meaning explains purpose; blank cells are self-evident primitives. Richer explanation lives only in surrounding prose never inside a cell.

sections.title: Composition
sections.summary: PresetBody requires a name and ordered prompts manuscript plus thirteen optional fields: groups and choices collections; samplers, systemPrompts, templates, behavior, apiOptions, media, and generation sub-objects; description and enabled scalars; and behaviorRefs plus quickReplyRefs link arrays. Grouping mirrors authoring rather than app storage. The complete generated field table lives under Full composition.

sections.title: Prompt blocks and groups
sections.summary: PresetPrompt is one manuscript row mapping directly to SillyTavern, RoleCall, or Marinara sections. id remains the verbatim source identifier because ordering, references, markers, and isDefault depend on it. role accepts system, user, assistant, or tool; adapters must preserve a supported tool role or report its loss instead of silently coercing it. Per-block systemPrompt differs from preset-level systemPrompts. placement uses the shared position-picker union, while marker blocks use markerSlot; the feature markers trackers, linkedTrackers and storyboards put that feature's messages where the block stands with its role (an append marker becomes its own message at that depth, the block's own text is not sent), and a preset without one keeps the feature's own spot. SillyTavern import reads the slot from the id, so only a marker whose id is its slot survives that round trip. Injection, grouping, XML wrapping, trigger, default, and extras fields complete the block. PresetGroup first-classes authored folders; SillyTavern derives divider ids for native drafts and escrows original divider ids only for imported groups.

children.title: Groups
children.summary: PresetGroup is a category or folder of blocks first-class because Marinara groups and RC categories are authored. ST has no real groups and encodes dividers; the ST codec derives divider identifier deterministically from group id for vaud-authored groups and escrows original divider id only for imported ST groups so add rename move never invent escrow. Fields include id name optional content parentGroupId order enabled extras.

sections.title: Sampler and generation settings
sections.summary: Sampler and generation knobs are all optional: absent stays absent because round-trip forbids emitting values the source never had. Build applies defaults at compile time none stored on the entity. Surfaces match presets-core SamplerSettings and GenerationSettings. temperature topP topK topA minP penalties maxContext maxTokens promptPostProcessing contextMode tokens or messages and maxMessages when messages mode, which a scene honors: it sends the newest N prior messages plus the one it answers, greeting kept, and a scene override wins. Generation child covers seed completions maxContextUnlocked biasPreset.

children.title: Generation
children.summary: Generation settings include optional seed completions as number of completions presets-core n maxContextUnlocked boolean and biasPreset string. All optional following the same absent-stays-absent round-trip rule as samplers.

sections.title: System prompts, templates, and behavior
sections.summary: Three optional sub-objects assemble requests around the manuscript with every nested field optional too. systemPrompts carries always-on utility prompts impersonation newChat newGroupChat newExampleChat continueNudge groupNudge assistantPrefill assistantImpersonation. Templates child has worldInfoFormat scenarioFormat personalityFormat Handlebars-ish card field strings. Behavior child has wrapInQuotes namesBehavior as ST numeric enum kept verbatim sendIfEmpty continuePrefill continuePostfix message-assembly flags.

children.title: Templates
children.summary: PresetTemplates holds optional worldInfoFormat scenarioFormat and personalityFormat Handlebars-ish format strings for card fields matching presets-core TemplateFormats used when assembling requests around the manuscript.

children.title: Behavior
children.summary: PresetBehavior message-assembly flags: wrapInQuotes, namesBehavior as ST names_behavior numeric enum kept verbatim not decoded to a named union, sendIfEmpty, continuePrefill, and continuePostfix. All optional.

sections.title: API and media options
sections.summary: API and media options hold provider and request-level toggles as two optional sub-objects with every nested field optional too matching presets-core APIOptions and MediaSettings. apiOptions covers streamResponses for streaming replies, claudeUseSystemPrompt and useMakerSuiteSystemPrompt for provider system-prompt shapes, squashSystemMessages, functionCalling, showThoughts, reasoningEffort as a string dial, enableWebSearch, and requestImages. Media child covers imageInlining, inlineImageQuality string, and videoInlining for how media is embedded into provider requests. Absent fields stay absent under the round-trip law the same as samplers; nothing here is executed by the converter or LiveBuild preview.

children.title: Media
children.summary: PresetMedia optional imageInlining boolean inlineImageQuality string and videoInlining boolean control how images and video are inlined into provider requests for the preset.

sections.title: Choices walkthrough
sections.summary: PresetChoice unifies Marinara choiceBlock and RC ChoiceGroup: authored now run later when a run surface exists. Answers feed getvar key gate blocks via enablesPrompts or write scoped state via set. type one many toggle input with default shaped to match; options min placeholder suggestions separator randomPick sortOrder extras. Options child carries value enablesPrompts and set first-class so each source keeps its effect without dropping the others. In a scene the answers are kept per preset and group (ChatStore rule 42) and applied by the assembler as RoleCall's loader does: groups are checked as parseGroup checks them, the answers are the baseline for the blocks a group names, the scene's own switches win, choice and chosen macros read them, and set is kept but never applied.

children.title: Options
children.summary: PresetChoiceOption has id label optional description Marinara value for the choice variable RC enablesPrompts block ids gated while selected and RC set scoped state writes. All three effects are first-class; a source using one leaves others empty rather than collapsing shapes.

sections.title: Full composition
sections.summary: PresetBody contains name, description, enabled state, ordered prompt blocks, group categories, samplers, systemPrompts, templates, behavior, apiOptions, media, generation, and choices. behaviorRefs links canonical regex sets and quickReplyRefs links canonical quick-reply sets without copying either payload into the stored preset. Disabled presets skip export. Dividers are never prompt blocks; groups model structure directly.

sections.title: Linked regex sets
sections.summary: behaviorRefs names standalone regex pieces by canonical id, keeping each set independently editable. SillyTavern and RoleCall can embed linked regex rows under extensions.regex_scripts; Lumiverse attaches scripts by preset_id; Marinara has no preset-level regex attachment. Each adapter owns that decision, and Press reports links that cannot ride instead of dropping them silently. quickReplyRefs applies the same canonical link model to quick-reply sets. Workbench exposes both link collections as checkboxes, and Press resolves every rider by kind and id so identical ids across different content kinds cannot collide.

sections.title: The writing family
sections.summary: A preset is one of the writing setups a scene can follow, with the Script Sheet: separate kinds that read one way. Each kind.ts gives asPreset, a preset's being its own body, and src/core/writing.ts reads the family from that. The scene's Writing slot records the kind with the id so one picker lists presets and sheets together, and a sheet joins the preset deck in the Library, shown as Writing.

sections.title: What rides escrow, not a field
sections.summary: Design principle: model what the editor or domain authors canonically; escrow pure source-wire fidelity no editor touches. groups and choices are canonical not escrow because Marinara and RC author them. Rides escrow: ST per-character prompt_order overrides, Marinara variable layer, original divider identifier for imported ST PresetGroup, and extras bags on prompt group and choice sealed leftovers. Does NOT ride escrow: groups and choices themselves first-classed.

sections.title: See also
sections.summary: Related authority is architecture.md for the canonical model escrow hub-and-spoke and the adapter contract. That contract currently excludes preset from the FormatAdapter union so no toCanonical fromCanonical pair ships yet while Library and Workbench still author PresetBody directly through createAndOpenPreset and PresetEditorView.
